title: Car Equipment
description: Shared read-only vehicle equipment detection for BMRMODZ OSA, DPF Monitor and future BMW MGU apps. Reads the Vehicle Order (FA/VO) using the same gateway DID and validated decoder as Climate Comfort, caches option codes, and answers single or batch equipment checks via a local Unix socket. Missing equipment returns false only after a valid VO read; unavailable/invalid VO returns unknown. Initial development build: a compatible MGU diagnostic transport adapter is required before in-car operation.
